nodes.text: You sprint through the graveyard! You nimbly dodge around tombstones and burial plots to make it to the gate.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Whew.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Stay close!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stay together!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There's a way out up here... We just have to crawl through this tunnel. I'm not sure where we'll come out...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I can see moonlight. And that means it's better than being trapped down here!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: $ZOE, you okay? Raven, are you with us?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm in the tunnel... I think I can almost see... The way out!
Suddenly, you emerge out of the basement and find yourselves on the football field of Centerscore University!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You think a little bit of garlic is going to save you?! Everyone! Attack!
The vampires rush at you!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: They're too strong!

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Hiss!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We can't fight them all!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Foolish humans!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Just hold on... Just keep fighting... I know we'll win!
The next day...

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Looks like something bad happened on this football field... Something `real` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like something bad happened on this football field... Something [i]real[/i] bad.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I get it, there were some disappearances on campus, so they called in the police to check it out...

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: But there's nothing here that adds up! Where did everyone go?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: There just aren't any clues...
We're not paranormal detectives, Mal.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Whatever happened here... There's nothing we can do for these kids now.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: You're right. We'd better get back to working on the Maskmaker case.
Oh no! Detectives called in to investigate? Everyone missing? This is a terrible ending!
Try again and see if you can get the good ending!

args.text: Try again for a better ending!

nodes.text: You're about to throw the ball to Howard... When a vampire lineman tackles you!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Nooo!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I... I couldn't do it... I let the team down...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, you win some, you lose some.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Bring them all to me!
The vampire football team grabs the rest of your friends, and they drag all of you over to Angie.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aw, it's really too bad that you didn't put up more of a fight... This was just getting interesting.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Nooo!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Let go of me! Let go!

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Don't worry, Amanda... You're one of `us` now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, Amanda... You're one of [i]us[/i] now!

nodes.text: Dinah leans in and bites Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I... I don't feel so good...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's just the transformation... Don't worry. It gets better.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: You'll be so much happier as a vampire.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You know, I think you're right!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda! Nooo!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't worry, Taylor. This way, we can `all` be friends... Just come here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, Taylor. This way, we can [i]all[/i] be friends... Just come here...

nodes.text: Oh no! You can't leave $USR like this...
If only you had gotten that garlic to Howard!
Try again and see if you can beat the vampire football team!

args.text: Try again for a better ending!

nodes.text: You stumble through the basement... But you lose track of Taylor!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Taylor! Come back! Where are you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $USR? I was following `you!` Are we lost?
nodes.text_bbcode: $USR? I was following [i]you![/i] Are we lost?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: $ZOE? I was following `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE? I was following [i]you...[/i]

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh oh....
You hear the sounds of footsteps coming closer... And hissing...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't think that's Taylor... It sounds like...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Vampires!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Hiss! You're mine!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $Scott?! Don't do this!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Don't worry, $ZOE. Being a vampire is great... You'll love it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I don't want to be a vampire! I want to stay the way I am!

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Ooh, sorry, that's not one of the options.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Dinah, you don't have to do this!

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Come on, Raven. Aren't you ready to be goth again? We can wear black and lace and stay up all night writing poems!

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Just like old times...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Except we'll have to go drink blood!

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Okay, so it's a `little` different...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, so it's a [i]little[/i] different...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Come on, girls! We need to make a break for it! Run!
You start to sprint off, but someone in the darkness tackles you!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: She got to the football team?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That's right, kid. Give it up. If you'd made it out of the basement, you might have had a chance...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But down here? You're surrounded!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess we might as well join them.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Not like we have any other choice...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess I'm already wearing a vampire costume anyway...
Oh no! You let the vampires win!
Don't you want to see how this very special Halloween episode `really` ends?
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you want to see how this very special Halloween episode [b]really[/b] ends?

nodes.text: Try again!

args.text: Try again for a better ending!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Okay, I'm going to come clean with you guys.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: This isn't a costume. I'm a werebear.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: A... werebear?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oooh, so you can just shine a light with your stomach and light this place up?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: No, not `that` kind of bear. Just a normal bear.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, not [i]that[/i] kind of bear. Just a normal bear.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You mean like a werewolf, but for a bear.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Exactly. Amanda and Taylor are my pack.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You can all turn into bears?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not exactly... I turn into a cat.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm a bunny!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: But the reason I'm telling you all of this is because werebears have a very acute sense of smell...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: We can smell out the undead.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Are you trying to say that Angie's vampire costume...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: It's more than just a costume. Angie's really a vampire! With everyone in costume, I wasn't sure who the real vampire was, but now I know it was her.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Why didn't I see it sooner?! It's the perfect plan... Turn everyone into vampires when they're `already` dressed up as vampires!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why didn't I see it sooner?! It's the perfect plan... Turn everyone into vampires when they're [i]already[/i] dressed up as vampires!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That way we didn't know who to suspect!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hold up, everyone! I heard something!
Amanda's ears twitch.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: They're closing in!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: 'They'? I thought it was just Angie.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No... She's delivering us as a snack to her whole coven!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: That's why we came here tonight. This coven has been making aggressive moves, converting humans all over Centerscore. Someone needs to stop them.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But now we need to find a way out! Fast! They're almost on top of us!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Quick! My cat eyes let me see in the dark. Follow me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks, $USR. Now, let's check out that secret passage.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I don't like this...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It's pitch black down here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Where's the light, Angie?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, we're not going to make any progress without some light. Angie?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: ...Angie?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: She's gone! I knew it! This was a trap!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't get it, Phil. Why are you so suspicious of Angie?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: $USR, I can't believe you don't trust me. $ZOE, you trust me, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor? Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, I've got to side with Phil.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm a bunny!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh, sorry. Sometimes when I get bored with what's going on, I start thinking about something else.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What were you guys talking about?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: We were talking about getting out of here... While we still can.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmph. I can't believe no one trusts me...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I guess if I were really on your side, I would have warned you about the trap door.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Huh?
Angie reaches over and pulls on a candle holder on the wall... And the floor drops out underneath all of you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Help!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Dark!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Is everyone okay? Any serious injuries?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just a little sore.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: It was a pretty short drop.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But what was that?! Angie just sent us falling down a trap door? That's insane!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's not insane. It looks like we just got betrayed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But why?! Why would Angie do this? It doesn't make any sense!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Well, at least we know Phil was right about Angie...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks for trusting me.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: No problem. But... What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, can we get out of the creepy dark pit now?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Why did Angie even want us down here? Phil, what's going on?
Back in the living room...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Something is seriously wrong here. We've got to get out.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What do you mean? Did you find something?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: That 'fake' hospital room? It's got real blood in it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Real blood?! How could you tell?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Trust me, I could smell it.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: Hey, guys, has anyone seen Dinah? She was over in the library, but I can't find her now...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Dinah's missing?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We should go check it out. Don't worry. I'm sure she's just looking at something in the library.
In the library...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guys! I found one of Dinah's hair clips by this bookcase.
Angie holds up a lacey black hair clip with a fake black spider on it.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: That's Dinah's all right.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What happened to her?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Maybe it had something to do with this bookcase... Look at the books here...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: 'The Bloodening: A Dark History of Vampire Bloodpocalypse', 'Fact and Fiction: The Truth About Fangs', and 'Blood, Blood, Blood'... Yeah, there's something weird going on here.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: Let me take a look at one of those.
Brendan reaches for 'Blood, Blood, Blood'... But when he pulls on it, the entire bookcase swings open!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: A secret passage?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's so dark down there.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I bet that's where Dinah is. We've got to go down there.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you kidding?!

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but if Dinah's down there, I'm going to check it out.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I'm not about to let anything happen to Dinah and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Hold on, let's think about this rationally. Even if we go running down there, what are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're going to help our friends!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You know, I'm not sure I trust you, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Trust me? What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I've got a bad feeling about you...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If you ask me, the most suspicious thing going on around here was `your` sudden appearance.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you ask me, the most suspicious thing going on around here was [i]your[/i] sudden appearance.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's when $Scott disappeared!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I was standing right next to you when $Scott disappeared!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Everyone, you've got to trust me. Angie is dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Something weird is definitely going on, but all the signs point to Phil!
In the hospital-themed room...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wow.
On the counter, you see a display of saws and cleavers...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I don't think I'd want any doctor operating on me with those...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Tell me about it. Something's not right here...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, how could you feel comfortable with all this fake blood around? Why would they just have bags and bags of blood?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It's kind of a weird prop for a haunted house...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: That's no prop... This is real blood!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, something weird is going on here...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: We've got to get out of here.
In the witch's lair...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I can't see a thing in here.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That's the point. You're supposed to feel around and touch all of the witch's creepy ingredients... You know, all the body parts she collected for her magic!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, let's find that light switch.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You're not scared of the dark, are you?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: The dark is just the unknown...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Or it could be spiders, zombies, and monsters just waiting to eat us.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Hey! I found the display! Here, feel these eyeballs.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Those are just peeled grapes.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: How about these brains?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That's ground meat. Come on, give me something hard.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: How about this...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What was that? Was that you?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You're messing with me, aren't you? I swear, I felt something brush by my leg...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh, I hate to tell you this, but it wasn't me...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Okay, I'm starting to get a little freaked out. We need that light switch.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Here, I got it.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Huh... Just a normal room...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: But what was that...
A black cat runs out the door!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Heh, just a cat.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Whew. Let's... Not tell anyone about that, okay?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You mean that a cat scared you?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Yes, that would be what I was referring to.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Heh. Okay, fine.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, the important thing now is that we find everyone.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, we passed a haunted house on the way here. Maybe everyone went there?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Didn't we just see $Scott get dragged away by some mysterious monster? Do you really think he just wandered off?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but I wouldn't put it past him to be playing a practical joke on all of us.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Besides, that haunted house looked pretty suspicious. Maybe there's something actually sinister going on there.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I don't have any other ideas...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And I'm not a fan of sitting here and waiting for something to snatch me from this graveyard.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess we might as well check it out.
At the Haunted House...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, this is definitely creepy. What's with all these themed rooms?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Looks like there's a hospital room and a pitch black room over there that's completely dark.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There's also a library room over there.

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Ooh! I love haunted houses.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: This place gives me the creeps.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Oh, don't worry. Haunted houses are just normal places with some fake cobwebs and decorations.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know... I've got a bad feeling about this.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE's right. We don't want to stay here any longer than necessary.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sure there's a logical explanation for everything that's happening.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We just need to keep investigating.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Really? I'm not sure that's so wise...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You know, that's a really good costume, Angie... Almost too good.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, what's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That's funny... I was just thinking that `Phil` was acting suspicious... Now he's worried about Angie...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's funny... I was just thinking that [i]Phil[/i] was acting suspicious... Now he's worried about Angie...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, stay focused, everyone. Let's split up and search the house.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why does everyone always want to split up?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, why don't you and Brendan search that library over there?

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: I guess a library isn't so scary.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I'm going to search that hospital room. I could use some back up.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I want to go check out that witch's lair. $USR, want to come with me?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Huh? It's Halloween. Seemed like a graveyard would be a cool place to visit on Halloween.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, it's totally spooky!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ghosts!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Besides, $USR, I could ask you the same thing. What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, $USR, I could ask you the same thing. What are [i]you[/i] doing here?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... Good point.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, I guess I didn't learn anything from that.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That's an interesting costume.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: The costume? Uh, you know, girls love the werewolf thing these days, right?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Anyway, that's enough talk about this costume. This costume isn't that cool. I think we've all heard enough about costumes.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Huh... That was a weird reaction to that question. Phil's acting pretty suspicious... I wonder what he's hiding.
You sprint through the graveyard... And run right into a tombstone!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oof!
And fall into an open grave!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Aaaah! Buried alive! Buried alive!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $USR! Are you okay?
$ZOE runs over to help you up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hurry hurry hurry!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Thanks.
With $ZOE's help, you hobble to the main gate where Raven is waiting.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Wait a second... Did you hear that?
A snarling growl rumbles through the night...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That sounded like... Like a bear!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or a wolf! Or a lion! Or some kind of crazy animal!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And it sounds like it's getting closer! We've got to get out of here!
You search the rows of graves, looking near the tombstones.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey! Is that a cell phone? Raven, come take a look at this!
Raven comes running over.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That... Looks disturbingly familiar.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That's Denni's cell phone... The one she's been playing all night.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, that's a good sign, right? We must be on the right track...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Maybe... But Denni would `never` give up her cell phone! She's always texting people and playing games...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe... But Denni would [i]never[/i] give up her cell phone! She's always texting people and playing games...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: $USR, I'm starting to think something really bad might have happened to her.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Don't worry. We're getting close. We'll find her in no time.
You search the entrance gate to the cemetery...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey! I think I found something! Look at these tracks!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Um, I hate to break it to you, $USR, but those are `our` tracks. We just walked in this way, remember?
nodes.text_bbcode: Um, I hate to break it to you, $USR, but those are [i]our[/i] tracks. We just walked in this way, remember?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Come on, let's go check the rest of the cemetery.
Everyone continues searching the graveyard...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Now, have you tried calling him?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I left him five messages and a dozen texts.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Don't worry. We'll find him. I'll help you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: He'd never be able to cheat on a girl. He'd feel too guilty.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm sure he's got a good reason for disappearing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess you have a point... Heh, I don't know why I got so carried away.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: No college girl wants to make out with some high school kid.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But Howard's a football player! And he's so tall! I bet he'd totally pass for a college guy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I bet he's making out with `two` girls right now! That's a thing guys do in college, isn't it? Ewww!
nodes.text_bbcode: I bet he's making out with [i]two[/i] girls right now! That's a thing guys do in college, isn't it? Ewww!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa. Calm down! We'll find him, okay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And we also brought up Raven's sister. Have you met Denni?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sounds like you're charming `and` a great athlete...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like you're charming [i]and[/i] a great athlete...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Who wouldn't leave her cousin behind.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
